data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's mechanism restricts checklists to 'lossy linear projections,' but many high-performing checklists (e.g., diagnostic decision trees, sequential triage rules) encode non-linear interactions or conditional branching. By definitional fiat it excludes the very class of checklists most likely to outperform a bias-prone expert, so it does not argue against the claim as stated—it narrows the claim to a strawman and ignores that a checklist can capture non-linear structure the expert's intuition mishandles.
